phase: During original collection; before any label derivation or kappa computation.
authority: User authorized collection with failures retained; routine recorded recovery of calls that never produced an annotation.
timing: Supplement, not represented as part of original pre-collection freeze. Original336-call terminal-attempt rule and all failures remain preserved.
eligibility: FAILED only; no assistant event, no structured annotation, zero reported input/output/cache tokens; exact observed native fast-fail before init or sharp loader failure before inference. No invalid/low-quality/completed semantic response can be repeated.

original_frozen_rules: No G6/G2, category, distance, threshold, geometry or admissibility changes.
